title: A Dust Devil on Mars Was 12 Miles Tall

scenes.text: A dust devil on Mars was twelve miles tall.
NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter photographed it from space in March of 2012.
It was less than a football field wide, a thin column of spinning dust reaching twelve miles into the sky.
That's more than twice as tall as Mount Everest.
It was spotted on Amazonis Planitia, in the northern plains of Mars.
A tornado of dust, twelve miles high.

description:
A dust devil on Mars was about 12 miles tall, photographed by NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter in March 2012.
It was only about 70 meters wide, making it a thin tower of spinning dust more than twice as tall as Mount Everest.
Would you stand next to one?
first_comment: Bonus: it was less than a football field wide. Would you rather see a tornado on Earth or a dust devil on Mars?
